title: hedyotis pentandra
intro: Hedyotis pentandra, commonly known as Ceylon teasel or Pentandra, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hedyotis pentandra are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Hedyotis pentandra include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
